nsmbw-hd.name: New Super Mario Bros. Wii HD Texture Pack
nsmbw-hd.description: So far I think the entire UI has been retextured, along with some in-game stuff. All textures are created as uncompressed DDS so they match PNG in quality.
nsmbw-hd.author: Bighead

downloads.name: New Super Mario Bros. Wii HD Texture Pack v2.81

nymo-hd.name: nymo’s HD HUD Tweaks
nymo-hd.description: Replaced a handful of UI elements with higher resolution versions. Many textures (like the coin/star coin icon) have been sourced from New Super Mario Bros. U Deluxe, and text/font have been upscaled x3 via waifu2x. Mario's life icon was also sourced from the Nvidia shield release.
nymo-hd.note: This texture pack is meant to be applied on top of the other HD texture pack.
nymo-hd.author: nymo642

newerwii.name: Newer Super Mario  Bros. Wii
newerwii.description: Newer is a full unofficial sequel to New Super Mario Bros. Wii, crafted over the span of 3 years by a team of devoted Nintendo fans. Playable legally on any homebrew-enabled Wii; no piracy or hardware mods needed.
newerwii.author: Newer Team
